Before submitting this PR, please make sure to fill in these items:

## What's new?

1. Implemented this...
2. Implemented that...

## What's changed?

1. Changed this to that...

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran this code locally
- [ ] I wrote/updated necessary unit tests (target: 80%)
- [ ] I ran formatters / linters locally (`npm run format`, `dotnet format`, etc.)
- [ ] I built both apps locally if I touched both (`Frontend/ npm run build`, `Backend/ dotnet build`)
- [ ] I updated `BACKLOG.md` if a story status changed (`[ ]` → `[~]` → `[x]`)
- [ ] I updated `CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.md` if I changed a convention

## Promotion target

- [ ] PR target is `dev` (active integration)
- [ ] PR target is `qa` (promotion from `dev`)
- [ ] PR target is `main` (production promotion from `qa`)

> Reminder: do not target `local_env` — it's the maintainer's personal sandbox.

## BACKLOG references

Link the story / stories this PR implements, e.g. `BACKLOG.md#e4-skill-mechanic--spot-the-ball`.

## Other references

Issue links, related PRs, useful threads.
